**Physical interpretation.** The Mekong fire season normally peaks between pentad 11 and pentad 22. During El Niño / severe drought years, the burning phase advances by 3 pentads (15 days), with early onset detected at pentad 8. This is a genuine phenological shift in the fire regime, not a sensor artifact: the Standardized Fire Anomaly Index (SFAI) peaks at 3.1 σ above the 26-year baseline, exceeding the Amazon peak of 2.9 σ, indicating a stronger-than-baseline early-season anomaly in Mekong.

- El Niño 2010 (Feb 05, MODIS): 3175 detections — an early-season pulse consistent with the advanced phase.

**Physical interpretation.** A single MODIS thermal detection is not a point; it is an elliptical ground footprint whose dimensions grow with scan angle. This ellipse must be searched in full; treating the detection as a point would miss fire activity at the footprint edges — the Point-Buffer Illusion.
